financial.title: Financial Scenario
financial.disclaimer: Outputs are illustrative arithmetic ranges from the inputs above — not forecasts, profit promises, crop recommendations or guarantees. Range endpoints are not confidence intervals.
financial.costsHelp: Each category is a low–high range in {{currency}} per hectare per crop cycle. Leave blank if unknown, or remove categories that do not apply; removed standard categories are listed beside the results.
financial.sourcesHelp: Add one record per source, then link each cost, yield and price input to the source(s) that support it. A single generic source for the whole calculation is not enough when inputs come from different places.
financial.fixInputs: Fix the highlighted inputs to see results.
financial.specStatus: Financial specification v{{version}} — formulas approved by Bhagya with implementation conditions.
financial.dataPending: Input data status: pending sourced local values. Enter values with traceable sources; synthetic examples are not market or yield evidence.
financial.noSourcesYet: Add a source record above to link it here.
financial.syntheticInputs: Synthetic inputs in use: these results are arithmetic examples, not Sri Lankan market or yield evidence.

common.fixtureMode: Fixture mode: all data shown is synthetic and for interface development only.

home.title: Plan your next crop rotation
home.heroDescription: Bring farm history, NASA Earth observations, water constraints and transparent rotation scoring into one practical planning workspace.
home.journey: Set up a farm → review observations → compare rotation plans → test a rainfall scenario → ask the assistant → save the plan.
home.featureObserveText: Review traceable climate observations, coverage and limitations without presenting regional estimates as field measurements.
home.featureRotateText: Explore crop sequences with visible constraints, water-demand ranges, assumptions and explainable score components.
home.featureExplainText: Test hypothetical rainfall changes, inspect financial ranges and ask for explanations grounded in the current analysis.
home.workspaceText: Recent farms and saved plans remain on this browser in fixture mode.
home.noFarms: No farms yet on this browser.
